name: F5b_remove_dim_under
sw_rationale: Family 5 - remove the width dimension (c10) from F5a. Expected: dof=1. SolidWorks marks the entities that contribute the free DOF as 'under'. In this case the width direction is free: e1 and e3 (horizontal lines) lack a length constraint, so the width of the rect can vary. SolidWorks would mark the horizontal lines as under-defined. Confidence HIGH for dof=1. MEDIUM for which exact entities are 'under' (depends on solver DOF attribution).

expect._coord_notes: Width is free, height constrained to 50. At least one entity should have status='under'. SolidWorks flags e1 and e3 as under since their x-extent is unconstrained.
